<!-- pr-reviewer: 2a3b7f55c23a8cb31debf24435bed90fb1ddd9cc -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Thanks, Mike - a careful change with a clear decision record.

**What looks good**
- The verifier only widens what it reads (flank reach to the ball diameter); it can only add a non-blocking Scallop note, never soften one (`the_wider_flank_never_softens_the_old_reading`). The changed expectation in `verify::envelope_verdict_follows_the_stated_tol` reports MORE (a real ~0.085 mm cusp), so no under-reporting of material or gouge - the right direction under the Prime Directive. The envelope half is unchanged.
- No unwrap/expect/panic or raw indexing in `ridge_scan.rs`; provenance header present; scan.rs shrinks (431 -> 359), new file 276 lines.
- Decision record in `docs/decisions/212-scallop-reach.md`; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #212`; no CHANGELOG.md edit; no build.rs/deps/workflow/script changes.

**Local results (merged with current main, clean merge, own target dir)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-sim`: all suites pass, including `ridge_reach` 5/5 and `ridge_rest` 4/4
- `camcraft-app --test verify -- --include-ignored envelope_verdict_follows_the_stated_tol`: 1 passed
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean
- Not re-run here: the 88-fixture finish3d release lane and flow (taken from the PR's gate report).

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The changed heavy-lane expectation is the judgement call the author flagged; I agree with reporting the real cusp.
- `feat(sim)` commit: lands at the next minor cut per project flow.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
